meaning: three or five equal nominal noisy recordings of ONE trail; not distinct parallel trails; source=reference preservation only
stations: union of nonnegative whole1m arclength stations, every source-vertex chainage and total length; reference interpolates exactly along frozen source
normal: per-source-vertex normalized sum of incoming/outgoing unit tangents (endpoint single tangent), rotate90deg; interpolate adjacent vertex normals linearly along source segment and renormalize; refuse singular

noise.tipTaper: min over source vertices4 and8 of min(1,.2+.8*abs(s-tipChainage)/3)
noise.meanRole: analytical truth-side witness only; never scorer/capture input or prescribed engine averaging

rendering.occupancy: count full recording polylines with native-point distance<=.5m, each at most once
rendering.interpretation: fixed bounded display response; no probability/independence/noise-SD claim

oracle.required: reference/subdivided reference/analytical mean pass; every individual noisy recording fails; preserve both turntips and separated approach-return; shortcuts fail

scope: Additive controls only, no old27/prior2 relabeling, no model/coefficients/caps/qualification change
